result.instructions: Tools for Billomat, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are overdue right now and for which clients?"; "Give me total invoiced revenue per month for this year."; "Which offers are still open and waiting for an answer?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Billomat data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run billomat_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run billomat_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run billomat_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. billomat_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: billomat_create_client
tools.description: WRITE: create a new client (customer) in Billomat. Billomat assigns the client number. Nothing is sent to the client. Check billomat_list_clients first to avoid duplicates.

country_code.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, AT, CH.

first_name.description: First name of the contact person.

last_name.description: Last name of the contact person.

currency_code.description: ISO currency code, e.g. EUR (account default when omitted).

locale.description: Locale of the documents, e.g. de-DE.

tools.name: billomat_update_client
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing client (only the fields you pass are changed; everything else stays). Read the client first with billomat_get_client. Nothing is sent to the client.

country_code.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, AT, CH.

first_name.description: First name of the contact person.

last_name.description: Last name of the contact person.

currency_code.description: ISO currency code, e.g. EUR (account default when omitted).

locale.description: Locale of the documents, e.g. de-DE.

tools.name: billomat_create_article
tools.description: WRITE: create a new article (product or service) with a price. Billomat assigns the article number.

sales_price.description: Sales price (net or gross as the account is set up).

currency_code.description: ISO currency code, e.g. EUR (account default when omitted).

tools.name: billomat_create_draft_invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create an invoice as a DRAFT (Entwurf) for a client, with optional line items. The invoice is NOT completed, has no number yet and is NOT sent; review and complete it in Billomat. Nothing is charged.

currency_code.description: ISO currency code, e.g. EUR (account default when omitted).

net_gross.description: Whether prices are net or gross.

items.description: Line items (up to 200). More can be added to the draft later.

title.description: Item title (required unless article_id is given).

unit_price.description: Unit price, net or gross as net_gross of the document (required unless article_id is given).

tax_name.description: Tax name; with tax_rate overrides the standard tax of the account.

tax_rate.description: Tax rate in percent; the account's standard rate when omitted.

article_id.description: An article id (from billomat_list_articles): title, unit, price and tax missing here are taken from the article.

optional.description: Offers only: mark the item as optional (its price is left out of the total).

tools.name: billomat_add_invoice_item
tools.description: WRITE: add one line item to an invoice that is still a DRAFT (Billomat refuses it for any other status). Does not complete or send the invoice.

title.description: Item title (required unless article_id is given).

unit_price.description: Unit price, net or gross as net_gross of the document (required unless article_id is given).

tax_name.description: Tax name; with tax_rate overrides the standard tax of the account.

tax_rate.description: Tax rate in percent; the account's standard rate when omitted.

article_id.description: An article id (from billomat_list_articles): title, unit, price and tax missing here are taken from the article.

optional.description: Offers only: mark the item as optional (its price is left out of the total).

annotations.title: Add an item to a draft invoice
